comparison.objective: Pass a wafer carrier through a two-gate airlock without opening both gates together.
comparison.physical_skill: Turn-taking gate operation and constrained carrier transfer between arms.
comparison.success_condition: Carrier reaches the left stop, stays on its lane, both gates finish shut, and they are never open simultaneously.
comparison.reason: Tests safety interlocking and staged transfer; detailed numeric rubric is absent, but the objective and mechanism are unrelated to damper tuning.
